source: Dated original research snapshots; FPL registered-player season minutes and provider statuses
transformation: Away minus home shares; additive logit offset [delta, 0, -delta]

prospectiveEvidenceGate.rule: Upper confidence bound of paired candidate-minus-baseline error must be below zero for both metrics

notes: The threshold permits a first fit; it does not promise accuracy or automatic production use.
Missing old minutes remain missing. Stale/undated reports form a separate uncertainty feature.
Minutes are a player-role proxy inside the registered FPL squad, not full replacement quality.
Provider-published XIs are extracted only in the separate late window; no day-ahead leakage.
Changing the feature semantics or recipe requires a new protocol and prospective cohort.
